content:
maria: Heads-up — a few folks hit confusing errors in the sampleapp during onboarding. The messages make it hard to decide whether to retry, back off, or file a support ticket.

kevin: ugh. which SDKs?

maria: JS + Python repros so far. Go hasn't been exercised by the new sampleapp yet. Mostly around 401/403 wording and 429 vs 503: they look the same to users.

sam: can you paste an example?

maria: sure — from the frontend logs:
```
{
  "status": 429,
  "error": "Too many requests",
  "message": "Rate limit hit while calling /v1/generate"
}
```
and the client surface returns a string error like: `Request failed: Too many requests` — no retry hint, no Retry-After header surfaced.

nisha: that sucks. We should have typed exceptions so integrators can programmatically handle them (RateLimitError, AuthError, TransientError).

kevin: agreed. SDK parity issue: JS already has a RateLimitError class in the beta SDK but Python returns a generic HTTPError. Go returns an error string. We need a consistent contract.

maria: proposal: map common server statuses to typed errors + attach structured meta: code, retryable (bool), retry_after (seconds optional), docs_url, user_facing_message. Example shape:
```json
{
  "type": "RateLimitError",
  "code": "rate_limit.v1",
  "retryable": true,
  "retry_after": 12,
  "user_message": "You hit a usage limit. Try again in 12s or upgrade your plan.",
  "docs_url": "https://docs.redwood.ai/errors#rate-limit"
}
```

sam: love the user_message field. keeps toasts helpful. Also we should standardize the HTTP <-> error mapping: 401/403 -> AuthError (retryable:false, hint to re-auth), 429 -> RateLimitError (retryable:true, backoff hint), 502/503/504 -> TransientError (retryable:true, exponential backoff).

kevin: question: do we include a machine-readable retry_hint enum vs freeform text? SDKs could implement automatic backoff if present.

nisha: prefer both: retry_hint enum (none, immediate, fixed, exponential) + numeric retry_after when fixed. SDKs can interpret enum.

maria: also telemetry: include an error_id and sampling flag so support can link traces without leaking PII. Example: `error_id: "err_01F..."`.

dev-bot: deploybot: submitted patch to docs/errors -> PR #2123 (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2123) :white_check_mark:

kevin: OK — let's split work. I'll add the typed exceptions and enum to the JS + Python SDKs. Sam — can you add a small sampleapp change that surfaces `user_message` in the UI toast and falls back to a generic message? Nisha — can you write the error contract section in errors.md (include HTTP mapping table + sample shapes)?

sam: yep, will open a branch `sampleapp/error-hints` and add tests.

nisha: taking docs task. will include examples for auth refresh flow and sample retry code snippets.

maria: follow-ups: 1) ensure Retry-After header is surfaced if present, 2) ensure 401 includes `auth_step` (eg "reauth" or "refresh") so client UIs can prompt correctly, 3) make telemetry error_id mandatory for server-side logs.

kevin: timeline? can we get a small beta release next week for JS/Python?

maria: aiming for next-week beta. kevin please add a changelog note: `error-surface: introduced typed exceptions + machine retry hints`

sam: i'll validate sampleapp flows by Thurs.

nisha: docs PR by Wed EOD.

kevin: creating issues now and will tag y'all. assigning to sam/nisha/maria. :rocket:

maria: thanks — this should cut a lot of onboarding tickets. feel free to ping me on any copy decisions (:speech_balloon:).
